commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Valladolid are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
90+6' The resulting set piece from Valladolid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+6' Eray Comert (Valladolid) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
90+4' Anuar (Valladolid) reacts quickest to a cross from Adam Aznou, but slams his header well wide of the left post from around the penalty spot.
90+2' Here is a change. Arthur Melo is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona).
90+2' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Raul Moro (Valladolid) but poses no threat.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A quickly taken corner by Valladolid.
90' Raul Moro (Valladolid) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Valladolid win a corner.

86' What a save from Paulo Gazzaniga! Mario Martin (Valladolid) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising low header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
85' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
83' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Valladolid have a free kick.
80' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! David Lopez sprays a pass out to Cristhian Stuani (Girona), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:1.
80' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle after Ibrahim Alani (Valladolid) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. A free kick has been awarded to Girona.
78' Alejandro Frances (Girona) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
75' Raul Moro (Valladolid) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
74' Adam Aznou (Valladolid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Paulo Gazzaniga intercepts the ball.
74' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle as Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
72' Iago Parente (Valladolid) is being substituted because of an injury. Alvaro Rubio sends Tamas Nikitscher on the pitch.
72' The injury to Iago Parente (Valladolid) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
71' The attendance for today's match is 12664.
71' Michel has decided to make a change. Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) replaces Yaser Asprilla.
71' Substitution. Cristhian Stuani (Girona) in, Abel Ruiz out.
71' Adam Aznou (Valladolid) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
66' That's the end of the game for Juanmi Latasa, who is replaced by Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid).
66' Substitution. Ibrahim Alani (Valladolid) replaces Florian Grillitsch.
66' Alvaro Rubio has decided to substitute Henrique and he is replaced by Adam Aznou (Valladolid).
65' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
64' Some great controlled play and passing from Girona. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
63' Portu will be replaced by Ivan Martin (Girona).
58' The Valladolid players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Alejandro Quintero. NO PENALTY!
58' Celebrations by Valladolid are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
57' The players claim that Alejandro Frances (Girona) handled the ball and it seems they are right. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Valladolid.
57' The ball goes out for a corner. Valladolid can continue in their attacking effort.

56' Great first touch by Anuar (Valladolid) after collecting a pass deep into the box. He smashes the ball towards the roof of the net, but the keeper makes a fantastic reflex save and pushes it onto the bar. Brilliant goalkeeping!
55' Mario Martin (Valladolid) is able to continue to play.
55' Mario Martin (Valladolid) picks up an injury.
53' Valladolid work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
51' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for an infringement.
49' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.

48' What a wasted opportunity by Yaser Asprilla (Girona)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom right corner, but Karl Hein makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
46' David Lopez (Girona) jumps into a tackle and Alejandro Quintero signals a foul.
46' Half-time substitution. Michel decided to make a change. Arnau Martinez (Girona) is replaced by Alejandro Frances.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Alejandro Quintero has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.

44' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Mario Martin (Valladolid) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Paulo Gazzaniga easily catches the ball.
43' The ball is cleared after Raul Moro (Valladolid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
42' Alejandro Quintero blows the whistle, Oriol Romeu (Girona) is penalised for a foul.
40' Arnau Martinez (Girona) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul.
38' David Lopez (Girona) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
37' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is about to take a corner kick.

36' Great save! Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Karl Hein. Girona get a corner.
35' That was close by Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
33' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
31' Arthur Melo (Girona) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
29' Raul Moro (Valladolid) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Paulo Gazzaniga, who smothers the ball.
29' Valladolid take a short corner kick.
28' Girona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

28' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the left side of the target, but Karl Hein pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt. Good work from Girona as they win a corner.
23' Alvaro Rubio is forced to make a change. Chuki is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid).
23' The game is interrupted now, Chuki (Valladolid) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
20' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Portu (Girona) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
17' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
17' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Girona.
16' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Girona have a corner.
15' A corner kick by Valladolid is thwarted by the well prepared Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona).

15' Chuki (Valladolid) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Paulo Gazzaniga. Valladolid have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
12' Oriol Romeu (Girona) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
11' Mario Martin (Valladolid) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
9' Raul Moro (Valladolid) goes on a mazy run, gets into the box and from around the penalty spot he misses the target. What a chance that was!
6' Henrique (Valladolid) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
4' Daley Blind (Girona) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
2' Juanpe (Girona) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul.
1' Daley Blind (Girona) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Girona will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Alejandro Quintero.
